messages.author: e13072fd07a5d80a
messages.subject: change password
parts:
Is it possible for the user to change their password from inside the app? So basically, after the user as logged in, they could confirm the current password and create a new password and this would update without any manual steps from me.

Thanks,
Josh

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: change password

-Andy
